entries.text: You see Talus.

entries.source_text: 你看到塔鲁斯。

entries.text: Hello, you must be the outsider initiate. Nice to meet you. # What can I do for you?
entries.source_text:
Hello, you must be the outsider initiate. Nice to meet you.
 # What can I do for you?

entries.text: 你好，你一定是外面来的。很高兴见到你。能为你做点什么？
entries.source_text: 你好，你一定是外面来的。很高兴见到你。能为你做点什么？

entries.text: Who is the leader of your organization?
entries.source_text: Who is the leader of your organization?

entries.text: 你们组织谁负责？
entries.source_text: 你们组织谁负责？

entries.text: So, are you in charge around here?
entries.source_text: So, are you in charge around here?

entries.text: 那么，你负责这里吗？
entries.source_text: 那么，你负责这里吗？

entries.text: How do I get better weapons and equipment?
entries.source_text: How do I get better weapons and equipment?

entries.text: 我怎么才能弄到更好的武器和装甲？
entries.source_text: 我怎么才能弄到更好的武器和装甲？

entries.text: Chagga!
entries.source_text: Chagga!

entries.text: 查格!
entries.source_text: 查格!

entries.text: That would be the council of elders. More specifically, the # High Elder, Maxson. The elders make all the major decisions # around here. If you need to speak with them, you'll find them # on the fourth floor.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: 那可能是议会元老。确切的说，是最高元老，马克松。元老制定这里所有的规则。如果你想和他们谈话，那就去四层。
entries.source_text: 那可能是议会元老。确切的说，是最高元老，马克松。元老制定这里所有的规则。如果你想和他们谈话，那就去四层。

entries.text: So what do you do?
entries.source_text: So what do you do?

entries.text: 那么你想干什么？
entries.source_text: 那么你想干什么？

entries.text: No, we are directed by the council of elders. Maxson, the High # Elder, would be the person in charge. If you need to speak with # him, you'll find him on the fourth floor.
entries.source_text:
No, we are directed by the council of elders. Maxson, the High
 # Elder, would be the person in charge. If you need to speak with
 # him, you'll find him on the fourth floor.

entries.text: 不，我们都受议会元老管理。马克松，最高元老，是这里的负责人。如果你想和他谈话，那就去四层。
entries.source_text: 不，我们都受议会元老管理。马克松，最高元老，是这里的负责人。如果你想和他谈话，那就去四层。

entries.text: I really need some better firepower.
entries.source_text: I really need some better firepower.

entries.text: 我真的需要更好的武器。
entries.source_text: 我真的需要更好的武器。

entries.text: I'm the Senior Paladin, Rhombus's right-hand man. We're in charge # of the Paladins and Knights. Right now I'm supervising training # exercises. We're getting ready . . . for anything.
entries.source_text:
I'm the Senior Paladin, Rhombus's right-hand man. We're in charge
 # of the Paladins and Knights. Right now I'm supervising training
 # exercises. We're getting ready . . . for anything.

entries.text: 我是资深游侠，隆伯斯的得力助手。我们管理着整个游侠和骑士。我要立刻开始训练。我们时刻准备着……
entries.source_text: 我是资深游侠，隆伯斯的得力助手。我们管理着整个游侠和骑士。我要立刻开始训练。我们时刻准备着……

entries.text: You're getting ready for what?
entries.source_text: You're getting ready for what?

entries.text: 你们准备着什么？
entries.source_text: 你们准备着什么？

entries.text: How can I get some weapons and equipment?
entries.source_text: How can I get some weapons and equipment?

entries.text: 我怎样才能得到一些武器和装备？
entries.source_text: 我怎样才能得到一些武器和装备？

entries.text: There are rumors of a large force moving around in the mountains # and desert. With the missing caravans and these rumors, we're just playing # it safe.
entries.source_text:
There are rumors of a large force moving around in the mountains
 # and desert. With the missing caravans and these rumors, we're just playing
 # it safe.

entries.text: 据说有一支强大的力量控制了山脉和沙漠边缘。听说一些商队失踪了，我们要保护他们的安全。
entries.source_text: 据说有一支强大的力量控制了山脉和沙漠边缘。听说一些商队失踪了，我们要保护他们的安全。

entries.text: Really? Okay, thanks.
entries.source_text: Really? Okay, thanks.

entries.text: 真的？好的，谢谢。
entries.source_text: 真的？好的，谢谢。

entries.text: In a hurry, are we? As an Initiate, you are entitled to a few # things. I'll put in a clearance for combat armor and three orders # for ammunition, bullets of your choice. Just see Michael in the # next room for the supplies.
entries.source_text:
In a hurry, are we? As an Initiate, you are entitled to a few
 # things. I'll put in a clearance for combat armor and three orders
 # for ammunition, bullets of your choice. Just see Michael in the
 # next room for the supplies.

entries.text: 这么急，不会吧？作为新兵，你会得到一些装备。我会给你一件战斗装甲和三件武器，以及一些弹药。去隔壁的军需官迈克尔那里领装备吧。
entries.source_text: 这么急，不会吧？作为新兵，你会得到一些装备。我会给你一件战斗装甲和三件武器，以及一些弹药。去隔壁的军需官迈克尔那里领装备吧。

entries.text: I am very grateful, but do you by any chance have a weapon you # can spare that might help my chances of survival out there?
entries.source_text:
I am very grateful, but do you by any chance have a weapon you
 # can spare that might help my chances of survival out there?

entries.text: 我很感谢，但你是不是有多余的武器给我这个幸运的人去那边冒险？
entries.source_text: 我很感谢，但你是不是有多余的武器给我这个幸运的人去那边冒险？

entries.text: Thanks, what about some high-tech weapons?
entries.source_text: Thanks, what about some high-tech weapons?

entries.text: 谢谢，有一些高科技武器吗？
entries.source_text: 谢谢，有一些高科技武器吗？

entries.text: That's it? You've got to be kidding!
entries.source_text: That's it? You've got to be kidding!

entries.text: 什么？你在开玩笑吗？
entries.source_text: 什么？你在开玩笑吗？

entries.text: I understand, but I'm really pressed for time and I really need # some better firepower.
entries.source_text:
I understand, but I'm really pressed for time and I really need
 # some better firepower.

entries.text: 我了解，但我真的没有时间并且我确实需要一些好武器。
entries.source_text: 我了解，但我真的没有时间并且我确实需要一些好武器。

entries.text: Great! What do I have to do now? Climb the highest mountain?
entries.source_text: Great! What do I have to do now? Climb the highest mountain?

entries.text: 很好！我现在该做什么？去爬最高的那座山峰吗？
entries.source_text: 很好！我现在该做什么？去爬最高的那座山峰吗？

entries.text: That sounds great. Why don't you start now.
entries.source_text: That sounds great. Why don't you start now.

entries.text: 听起来不错。为什么你现在不去呢。
entries.source_text: 听起来不错。为什么你现在不去呢。

entries.text: Well, I might be able to make an exception. You obviously have # some good training. If you didn't you wouldn't have succeeded # in that crazy quest the High Elder sent you on.
entries.source_text:
Well, I might be able to make an exception. You obviously have
 # some good training. If you didn't you wouldn't have succeeded
 # in that crazy quest the High Elder sent you on.

entries.text: 好吧，我可以破例一次。你显然受到专业训练。如果你不能完成最高元老那变态的任务的话。
entries.source_text: 好吧，我可以破例一次。你显然受到专业训练。如果你不能完成最高元老那变态的任务的话。

entries.text: Sometimes I don't know if he's trying to get help from the # outside, or kill off the stupid. No offense. I'll tell you # what. I'm sort of in a tight spot because the scouts I # sent out a while back never returned.
entries.source_text:
Sometimes I don't know if he's trying to get help from the
 # outside, or kill off the stupid. No offense. I'll tell you
 # what. I'm sort of in a tight spot because the scouts I
 # sent out a while back never returned.

entries.text: 有时我真不知道他是需要寻求帮助，还是消灭了那些白痴。不是冒犯你。我会告诉你一切。我正处于紧要关头因为我派出去的侦察兵再也没有回来。
entries.source_text: 有时我真不知道他是需要寻求帮助，还是消灭了那些白痴。不是冒犯你。我会告诉你一切。我正处于紧要关头因为我派出去的侦察兵再也没有回来。

entries.text: It was my idea, and I'm sort of taking some heat for it. # If you can find out what happened to them, I'll make it # worth your while.
entries.source_text:
It was my idea, and I'm sort of taking some heat for it.
 # If you can find out what happened to them, I'll make it
 # worth your while.

entries.text: 这就是我的主意，我很想得到它的一些消息。如果你能发现它们出了什么事，我会给你报酬的。
entries.source_text: 这就是我的主意，我很想得到它的一些消息。如果你能发现它们出了什么事，我会给你报酬的。

entries.text: I'll think about it.
entries.source_text: I'll think about it.

entries.text: 我会考虑的。
entries.source_text: 我会考虑的。

entries.text: Excuse me, Initiate. Please don't brandish your weapon. Put it # away unless you plan on using it.
entries.source_text:
Excuse me, Initiate. Please don't brandish your weapon. Put it

entries.text: 打搅一下，新兵。不要拿着你的武器。把它拿开除非你打算用它。
entries.source_text: 打搅一下，新兵。不要拿着你的武器。把它拿开除非你打算用它。

entries.text: Holster your weapon, Initiate. You're not in a training exercise, # put it away.
entries.source_text:
Holster your weapon, Initiate. You're not in a training exercise,
 # put it away.

entries.text: 收起你的武器，新兵。你不是在训练，拿开它。
entries.source_text: 收起你的武器，新兵。你不是在训练，拿开它。

entries.text: Would you stop waving your weapon around like that? # You should . . . oh, never mind.
entries.source_text:
Would you stop waving your weapon around like that?

entries.text: 你会像那样停止挥舞你的武器吗？你应该……哦，别介意。
entries.source_text: 你会像那样停止挥舞你的武器吗？你应该……哦，别介意。

entries.text: Hello again, Brother
entries.source_text: Hello again, Brother

entries.text: 再次欢迎，兄弟

entries.source_text: 谁是这里的负责人？

entries.text: Could you tell me about those important people again?
entries.source_text: Could you tell me about those important people again?

entries.text: What about that metal suit you're wearing?
entries.source_text: What about that metal suit you're wearing?

entries.text: 你穿的那件铁装甲怎么样？
entries.source_text: 你穿的那件铁装甲怎么样？

entries.source_text: Thanks, what about some high-tech weapons?

entries.text: 谢谢，那些高科技武器如何？
entries.source_text: 谢谢，那些高科技武器如何？

entries.text: Well, we are all important, but I know who you are referring to.
entries.source_text: Well, we are all important, but I know who you are referring to.

entries.text: 好的，我们都是重要人物，但我知道你说的是谁。
entries.source_text: 好的，我们都是重要人物，但我知道你说的是谁。

entries.text: That's not a problem. You should get to know your fellow Brothers # well. I know there are a lot of us, and that it can be hard  #for some to remember us all.
entries.source_text:
That's not a problem. You should get to know your fellow Brothers
 # well. I know there are a lot of us, and that it can be hard 
 #for some to remember us all.

entries.text: 那不是问题。你应该去了解一下你的伙伴。我知道那里有我们很多人，要全都记住并不容易。
entries.source_text: 那不是问题。你应该去了解一下你的伙伴。我知道那里有我们很多人，要全都记住并不容易。

entries.text: There's Rhombus. He's our Head Paladin, also known as the Master # Knight. Then there's Vree; she's the Master Scribe. And of course # we cannot forget our distinguished High Elder, Maxson.
entries.source_text:
There's Rhombus. He's our Head Paladin, also known as the Master
 # Knight. Then there's Vree; she's the Master Scribe. And of course
 # we cannot forget our distinguished High Elder, Maxson.

entries.text: 那是隆伯斯。他是我们的首席游侠，当然也是大师骑士。然后那边的是弗蕾；她是首席研究员。当然我们不会忘记我们伟大的最高元老，马克松。
entries.source_text: 那是隆伯斯。他是我们的首席游侠，当然也是大师骑士。然后那边的是弗蕾；她是首席研究员。当然我们不会忘记我们伟大的最高元老，马克松。

entries.text: Tell me about Rhombus.
entries.source_text: Tell me about Rhombus.

entries.text: 告诉我有关隆伯斯的事情。
entries.source_text: 告诉我有关隆伯斯的事情。

entries.text: Tell me about Vree.
entries.source_text: Tell me about Vree.

entries.text: 告诉我有关弗蕾的事情。
entries.source_text: 告诉我有关弗蕾的事情。

entries.text: Tell me about Maxson.
entries.source_text: Tell me about Maxson.

entries.text: 告诉我有关马克松的事情。
entries.source_text: 告诉我有关马克松的事情。

entries.text: Rhombus is my best friend, mentor, idol, and father figure all # combined into one. He's a little rough, but he has to be, # to be in the position he's in.
entries.source_text:
Rhombus is my best friend, mentor, idol, and father figure all
 # combined into one. He's a little rough, but he has to be,
 # to be in the position he's in.

entries.text: 隆伯斯是我最好的朋友，导师，偶像和父亲的综合。他有点粗暴，但他毫无疑问，他毫无疑问有着很高的地位。
entries.source_text: 隆伯斯是我最好的朋友，导师，偶像和父亲的综合。他有点粗暴，但他毫无疑问，他毫无疑问有着很高的地位。

entries.text: If you ever need to talk to him, he is normally in his office . . . # I mean room. That's on the other side of this level, across from # the guard room.
entries.source_text:
If you ever need to talk to him, he is normally in his office . . .
 # I mean room. That's on the other side of this level, across from
 # the guard room.

entries.text: 如果你想和他谈话，他通常都在他的办公室里……我的意思是房间。在这层的另一边，穿过警卫室就到了。
entries.source_text: 如果你想和他谈话，他通常都在他的办公室里……我的意思是房间。在这层的另一边，穿过警卫室就到了。

entries.text: Of course we do. She's on the second level. Next to the learning room.
entries.source_text: Of course we do. She's on the second level. Next to the learning room.

entries.text: 当然，这是我们应该做的。她在二楼。电子图书馆隔壁。
entries.source_text: 当然，这是我们应该做的。她在二楼。电子图书馆隔壁。

entries.text: Thanks, bye.
entries.source_text: Thanks, bye.

entries.text: 谢谢，再见。
entries.source_text: 谢谢，再见。

entries.text: Thank you. That's all I wanted to know.
entries.source_text: Thank you. That's all I wanted to know.

entries.text: 谢谢，那就是我想知道的。
entries.source_text: 谢谢，那就是我想知道的。

entries.text: Vree is one of the most intelligent people I've ever known. # I think she was born with the natural understanding of physics and chemistry.
entries.source_text:
Vree is one of the most intelligent people I've ever known.
 # I think she was born with the natural understanding of physics and chemistry.

entries.text: 弗蕾是我见到过的最聪明的人。据我所知她有物理和化学的天赋。
entries.source_text: 弗蕾是我见到过的最聪明的人。据我所知她有物理和化学的天赋。

entries.text: She spends every waking moment doing research or analyzing and # reanalyzing anything she can get her hands on. If you ever need # to talk to her, she can normally be found in her room, on the third floor.
entries.source_text:
She spends every waking moment doing research or analyzing and
 # reanalyzing anything she can get her hands on. If you ever need
 # to talk to her, she can normally be found in her room, on the third floor.

entries.text: 她花很少的时间就可以研究或者分析，并且得出结论。如果你想和她谈话，通常你可以在她的房间找到她，在三层。
entries.source_text: 她花很少的时间就可以研究或者分析，并且得出结论。如果你想和她谈话，通常你可以在她的房间找到她，在三层。

entries.text: She's on the second level. Just go down to the second floor, make # a left. You'll see it just past the learning room. I should get back to # work. If you have any other questions just ask.
entries.source_text:
She's on the second level. Just go down to the second floor, make

 # work. If you have any other questions just ask.

entries.text: 她在二层。到二层，左拐。穿过电子图书馆你就会见到。我要去工作了。如果你有问题的话就问吧。
entries.source_text: 她在二层。到二层，左拐。穿过电子图书馆你就会见到。我要去工作了。如果你有问题的话就问吧。

entries.text: As I said, she's on the second level. You can't miss it. It's the # only other major room on the second floor besides the learning room.
entries.source_text:
As I said, she's on the second level. You can't miss it. It's the
 # only other major room on the second floor besides the learning room.

entries.text: 正如我说的，她在二层。你不会找不到的。那是除电子图书馆外最大的房间。
entries.source_text: 正如我说的，她在二层。你不会找不到的。那是除电子图书馆外最大的房间。

entries.text: Okay, see ya.
entries.source_text: Okay, see ya.

entries.text: 好的，再见。
entries.source_text: 好的，再见。

entries.text: Maxson is one tough old man. He's the great, great grandson . . . # or was it great, great, great grandson? Well, anyway. He's the # descendant of one of our founding fathers. He, of course, is the # High Elder.
entries.source_text:
Maxson is one tough old man. He's the great, great grandson . . .
 # or was it great, great, great grandson? Well, anyway. He's the
 # descendant of one of our founding fathers. He, of course, is the
 # High Elder.

entries.text: 马克松是个坚强的老人。他是伟大的，伟大的后裔……或者是伟大的，伟大的，伟大的后裔？好吧，总而言之。他是我们祖先的后代。他，当然，也是最高元老。
entries.source_text: 马克松是个坚强的老人。他是伟大的，伟大的后裔……或者是伟大的，伟大的，伟大的后裔？好吧，总而言之。他是我们祖先的后代。他，当然，也是最高元老。

entries.text: You've built quite a reputation for yourself. The people I've # checked with hold you in high regard. I don't think you need any help, # you seem quite capable. However, if you help me with a little problem, # I might be able to reward you with something.
entries.source_text:
You've built quite a reputation for yourself. The people I've
 # checked with hold you in high regard. I don't think you need any help,
 # you seem quite capable. However, if you help me with a little problem,
 # I might be able to reward you with something.

entries.text: 你的声望很高。我的人十分关注你。我不认为你需要任何帮助，你看起来很能干。然而，如果你能帮我个小忙，我会给你报酬的。
entries.source_text: 你的声望很高。我的人十分关注你。我不认为你需要任何帮助，你看起来很能干。然而，如果你能帮我个小忙，我会给你报酬的。

entries.text: Thanks a lot, bye.
entries.source_text: Thanks a lot, bye.

entries.text: 十分感谢，再见。
entries.source_text: 十分感谢，再见。

entries.text: That's it, thanks.
entries.source_text: That's it, thanks.

entries.text: 就是那些，谢谢。
entries.source_text: 就是那些，谢谢。

entries.text: You're getting on my nerves, little one. What do you want now?
entries.source_text: You're getting on my nerves, little one. What do you want now?

entries.text: 你在挑战我的耐性，小子。你现在需要什么？
entries.source_text: 你在挑战我的耐性，小子。你现在需要什么？

entries.text: Nothing, just wanted to hear your pleasant voice.
entries.source_text: Nothing, just wanted to hear your pleasant voice.

entries.text: 没事，只是想听听你美妙的声音。
entries.source_text: 没事，只是想听听你美妙的声音。

entries.text: Sorry, didn't see you there.
entries.source_text: Sorry, didn't see you there.

entries.text: 抱歉，没看到你在这里。
entries.source_text: 抱歉，没看到你在这里。

entries.text: Cha Toh Weh Lo!
entries.source_text: Cha Toh Weh Lo!

entries.text: 你瞎了吗！
entries.source_text: 你瞎了吗！

entries.text: Ug.
entries.source_text: Ug.

entries.text: 唔。
entries.source_text: 唔。

entries.text: Stop wasting my time!
entries.source_text: Stop wasting my time!

entries.text: 不要浪费我的时间！
entries.source_text: 不要浪费我的时间！

entries.text: How did you get in here? Get out of my sight.
entries.source_text: How did you get in here? Get out of my sight.

entries.text: 你怎么进来的？滚出我的视线。
entries.source_text: 你怎么进来的？滚出我的视线。

entries.text: I can give you a little more ammunition if you really need # it. I'll have it authorized by the time you can talk to Michael.
entries.source_text:
I can give you a little more ammunition if you really need
 # it. I'll have it authorized by the time you can talk to Michael.

entries.text: 如果你需要的话我会给你一些军火。我需要你得到迈克尔的同意。
entries.source_text: 如果你需要的话我会给你一些军火。我需要你得到迈克尔的同意。

entries.text: I just gave you some. You should learn to be more # conservative with your ammunition.
entries.source_text:
I just gave you some. You should learn to be more
 # conservative with your ammunition.

entries.text: 我会给你一些。你要学会节省弹药。
entries.source_text: 我会给你一些。你要学会节省弹药。

entries.text: Sorry, you've had more than your share for this week. # You'll have to make do with what you have. We don't have an endless # supply of ammunition.
entries.source_text:
Sorry, you've had more than your share for this week.
 # You'll have to make do with what you have. We don't have an endless
 # supply of ammunition.

entries.text: 抱歉，你已经得到这星期的补给份额了。你该去做你的事了。我们不会无限提供弹药。
entries.source_text: 抱歉，你已经得到这星期的补给份额了。你该去做你的事了。我们不会无限提供弹药。

entries.text: I've heard about some of the things you've done and we don't # take kindly to child killers. The Elders seem to think that there's # something you can offer but I don't want to have anything to do with # you.
entries.source_text:
I've heard about some of the things you've done and we don't
 # take kindly to child killers. The Elders seem to think that there's
 # something you can offer but I don't want to have anything to do with
 # you.

entries.text: 我听说了你的事迹，我们是不会同杀小孩者打交道的。元老们认为这里可以给你提供一些东西但我不这么认为。
entries.source_text: 我听说了你的事迹，我们是不会同杀小孩者打交道的。元老们认为这里可以给你提供一些东西但我不这么认为。

entries.text: I only killed one.
entries.source_text: I only killed one.

entries.text: 我只是杀了一个。
entries.source_text: 我只是杀了一个。

entries.text: You don't know the whole story.
entries.source_text: You don't know the whole story.

entries.text: 你不了解整件事情。
entries.source_text: 你不了解整件事情。

entries.text: I don't have to answer to you.
entries.source_text: I don't have to answer to you.

entries.text: 我不能回答你。
entries.source_text: 我不能回答你。

entries.text: You've built quite a reputation for yourself. I don't think # you need any help, you seem quite capable. However, there is something # I need looking into, and I might be able to help you if you can help # me.
entries.source_text:
You've built quite a reputation for yourself. I don't think
 # you need any help, you seem quite capable. However, there is something
 # I need looking into, and I might be able to help you if you can help
 # me.

entries.text: 你的声望很高。我不认为你需要任何帮助，你看起来很能干。可是，有些事情我需要调察，如果你能帮我的话我会给你一些帮助。
entries.source_text: 你的声望很高。我不认为你需要任何帮助，你看起来很能干。可是，有些事情我需要调察，如果你能帮我的话我会给你一些帮助。

entries.text: Sure. What's the problem?
entries.source_text: Sure. What's the problem?

entries.text: 当然。什么问题？
entries.source_text: 当然。什么问题？

entries.text: No thanks and thanks for nothing.
entries.source_text: No thanks and thanks for nothing.

entries.text: 不用感谢任何人。
entries.source_text: 不用感谢任何人。

entries.text: Sorry, I can't. Thanks for the Armor, though.
entries.source_text: Sorry, I can't. Thanks for the Armor, though.

entries.text: 抱歉，我不能。感谢你的装甲，尽管我不能帮你。
entries.source_text: 抱歉，我不能。感谢你的装甲，尽管我不能帮你。

entries.text: Since you were able to survive the wasteland alone, I think # you're probably quite capable. However, I do have a problem that I # could use some help with and I might be able to reward you for your # help.
entries.source_text:
Since you were able to survive the wasteland alone, I think
 # you're probably quite capable. However, I do have a problem that I
 # could use some help with and I might be able to reward you for your
 # help.

entries.text: 既然你能在废土中独自生活，那么我认为你很有能力。然而，我有一些问题需要你的帮助，如果你帮忙的话我会给你报酬的。
entries.source_text: 既然你能在废土中独自生活，那么我认为你很有能力。然而，我有一些问题需要你的帮助，如果你帮忙的话我会给你报酬的。

entries.text: No. I think you should leave.
entries.source_text: No. I think you should leave.

entries.text: 不。我想你该离开了。
entries.source_text: 不。我想你该离开了。

entries.text: I sent one of our Initiates out to the Hub a short while back # and we haven't heard back from him. If you can find out what happened # to him I'd be very grateful.
entries.source_text:
I sent one of our Initiates out to the Hub a short while back
 # and we haven't heard back from him. If you can find out what happened
 # to him I'd be very grateful.

entries.text: 我曾经叫我的一个新兵去哈勃城一段时间但他再也没有消息了。如果你能找出他发生了什么事我会很感激的。
entries.source_text: 我曾经叫我的一个新兵去哈勃城一段时间但他再也没有消息了。如果你能找出他发生了什么事我会很感激的。

entries.text: I'll check it out.
entries.source_text: I'll check it out.

entries.text: 我会带他回来的。
entries.source_text: 我会带他回来的。

entries.text: I'll try but I can't promise anything.
entries.source_text: I'll try but I can't promise anything.

entries.text: 我会尽力的但我不能保证。
entries.source_text: 我会尽力的但我不能保证。

entries.text: I told you to leave.
entries.source_text: I told you to leave.

entries.text: 我来向你告辞的。
entries.source_text: 我来向你告辞的。

entries.text: Only? I don't think our order will be able to help you. Good day.
entries.source_text: Only? I don't think our order will be able to help you. Good day.

entries.text: 只有这些？我不认为我们的装备会对你有帮助。日安。
entries.source_text: 只有这些？我不认为我们的装备会对你有帮助。日安。

entries.text: I don't need to know the whole story. Good day.
entries.source_text: I don't need to know the whole story. Good day.

entries.text: 我不想了解整件事。日安。
entries.source_text: 我不想了解整件事。日安。

entries.text: Thank you. I'll remember this and when I've seen that you've gained # enough experience I might be able to give you something special from our # order.
entries.source_text:
Thank you. I'll remember this and when I've seen that you've gained
 # enough experience I might be able to give you something special from our
 # order.

entries.text: 谢谢。我会记得当你有足够经验时给你一些特殊装备。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。我会记得当你有足够经验时给你一些特殊装备。

entries.text: Really? What?
entries.source_text: Really? What?

entries.text: 真的？那是什么？
entries.source_text: 真的？那是什么？

entries.text: Give it to me now!
entries.source_text: Give it to me now!

entries.text: 现在就给我！
entries.source_text: 现在就给我！

entries.text: Sounds good. Bye.
entries.source_text: Sounds good. Bye.

entries.text: 听起来不错。再见。
entries.source_text: 听起来不错。再见。

entries.text: I shouldn't say, but it's not a weapon. It's something that only # the elite in our order can have, but since you are from the outside and # are in greater need of it, I might be able to make an exception.
entries.source_text:
I shouldn't say, but it's not a weapon. It's something that only
 # the elite in our order can have, but since you are from the outside and
 # are in greater need of it, I might be able to make an exception.

entries.text: 我不能说，但那不是武器。它是给我们的精英用的，但是你在外面十分需要，我会破例一次的。
entries.source_text: 我不能说，但那不是武器。它是给我们的精英用的，但是你在外面十分需要，我会破例一次的。

entries.text: Can't you tell me?
entries.source_text: Can't you tell me?

entries.text: 你不能告诉我？
entries.source_text: 你不能告诉我？

entries.text: Okay, bye.
entries.source_text: Okay, bye.

entries.text: 好的，再见。
entries.source_text: 好的，再见。

entries.text: I think you probably already have an idea. Let's leave it at that.
entries.source_text: I think you probably already have an idea. Let's leave it at that.

entries.text: 我希望你已经有了计划。让我们动身吧。
entries.source_text: 我希望你已经有了计划。让我们动身吧。

entries.text: No, I'm not and I think you should leave, 'initiate'.
entries.source_text: No, I'm not and I think you should leave, 'initiate'.

entries.text: 不，我不能，我想你应该离开了，“新兵”。
entries.source_text: 不，我不能，我想你应该离开了，“新兵”。

entries.text: Only Paladins wear Power Armor, someday you may earn the right to # wear it.
entries.source_text:
Only Paladins wear Power Armor, someday you may earn the right to
 # wear it.

entries.text: 只有游侠能够穿动力装甲，总有一天你会有机会穿它的。
entries.source_text: 只有游侠能够穿动力装甲，总有一天你会有机会穿它的。

entries.text: Thanks, what about some high-tech weapons?
entries.source_text: Thanks, what about some high-tech weapons?

entries.text: 谢谢，那高科技武器呢？
entries.source_text: 谢谢，那高科技武器呢？

entries.text: Well I see we have a bright new addition to our order after all... # 【Talus leers at you.】 Don't get cocky with me, Initiate. I'm not in the # mood nor have I the patience!
entries.source_text:
Well I see we have a bright new addition to our order after all...
 # 【Talus leers at you.】 Don't get cocky with me, Initiate. I'm not in the
 # mood nor have I the patience!

entries.text: 毕竟是我看见我们的队伍里又多了一个聪明的新人……【塔鲁斯与你同在。】不要在我面前托大，新兵。虽然我脾气好但也不要挑战我的耐性。
entries.source_text: 毕竟是我看见我们的队伍里又多了一个聪明的新人……【塔鲁斯与你同在。】不要在我面前托大，新兵。虽然我脾气好但也不要挑战我的耐性。

entries.text: I thought you were smarter than that. I don't have to give you # anything. You're lucky I don't kick you out of here, right now. I think # you should leave, before I change my mind.
entries.source_text:
I thought you were smarter than that. I don't have to give you
 # anything. You're lucky I don't kick you out of here, right now. I think
 # you should leave, before I change my mind.

entries.text: 我认为你很厉害。我没有东西能给你了。我没有立即把你踢出去，你真的很幸运。我想你该走了，在我没改变注意之前。
entries.source_text: 我认为你很厉害。我没有东西能给你了。我没有立即把你踢出去，你真的很幸运。我想你该走了，在我没改变注意之前。

entries.text: That's okay. Anything you might find would be helpful.
entries.source_text: That's okay. Anything you might find would be helpful.

entries.text: 好吧。你见到的任何事物都会有帮助的。
entries.source_text: 好吧。你见到的任何事物都会有帮助的。

entries.source_text: Brother

entries.source_text: 兄弟

! I've received word from Brother Jonathan. Thank you for rescuing
 # him.

entries.text: ！我收到了乔纳森兄弟的消息。谢谢你救了他。
entries.source_text: ！我收到了乔纳森兄弟的消息。谢谢你救了他。

entries.text: I understand Decker's dead, you're more talented than I thought, # and that's saying a lot.
entries.source_text:
I understand Decker's dead, you're more talented than I thought,
 # and that's saying a lot.

entries.text: 我听说德克死了，你比我想象的还要能干，而且评价很高。
entries.source_text: 我听说德克死了，你比我想象的还要能干，而且评价很高。

entries.text: We'll make Decker pay for what he's done, you have my word on that.
entries.source_text: We'll make Decker pay for what he's done, you have my word on that.

entries.text: 我们要让德克为他所做的付出代价，你照我说的去做。
entries.source_text: 我们要让德克为他所做的付出代价，你照我说的去做。

entries.text: You're welcome.
entries.source_text: You're welcome.

entries.text: 欢迎。
entries.source_text: 欢迎。

entries.text: Lup?
entries.source_text: Lup?

entries.text: 什么？
entries.source_text: 什么？

entries.text: Hello stranger! I heard you're the one to thank for the safe return # of my missing Initiate.
entries.source_text:
Hello stranger! I heard you're the one to thank for the safe return
 # of my missing Initiate.

entries.text: 你好陌生人！我听说你救回了我失踪的新兵，十分感谢。
entries.source_text: 你好陌生人！我听说你救回了我失踪的新兵，十分感谢。

entries.text: I also understand that Decker's dead, you're quite an asset to our # Brotherhood.
entries.source_text:
I also understand that Decker's dead, you're quite an asset to our
 # Brotherhood.

entries.text: 我也听说德克死了，你对我们兄弟会来说十分能干。
entries.source_text: 我也听说德克死了，你对我们兄弟会来说十分能干。

entries.text: We don't tolerate drug users around here. I suggest you see the # doctor and clean yourself up.
entries.source_text:
We don't tolerate drug users around here. I suggest you see the
 # doctor and clean yourself up.

entries.text: 我们不能容忍瘾君子在这附近。我建议你去看医生并清洗一下。
entries.source_text: 我们不能容忍瘾君子在这附近。我建议你去看医生并清洗一下。

entries.text: As for your reward, I'll give you the choice of one of the following:
entries.source_text: As for your reward, I'll give you the choice of one of the following:

entries.text: 作为你的报酬，我给你以下选择：
entries.source_text: 作为你的报酬，我给你以下选择：

entries.text: So which would you prefer?
entries.source_text: So which would you prefer?

entries.text: 你喜欢什么？
entries.source_text: 你喜欢什么？

entries.text: Rocket Launcher.
entries.source_text: Rocket Launcher.

entries.text: 火箭发射器。
entries.source_text: 火箭发射器。

entries.text: Laser Pistol.
entries.source_text: Laser Pistol.

entries.text: 激光手枪。
entries.source_text: 激光手枪。

entries.text: Super Sledgehammer.
entries.source_text: Super Sledgehammer.

entries.text: 超级铁锤。
entries.source_text: 超级铁锤。

entries.text: Let me think about it.
entries.source_text: Let me think about it.

entries.text: 让我想想。
entries.source_text: 让我想想。

entries.text: I'll key your authorization in right now. Go pick it up from Michael.
entries.source_text: I'll key your authorization in right now. Go pick it up from Michael.

entries.text: 我会立即给你授权。去迈克尔那里拿吧。
entries.source_text: 我会立即给你授权。去迈克尔那里拿吧。

entries.text: , it is time you wore your own suit of Power Armor. This is a very # special privilege for one so new to our order. Wear our Power Armor as a # symbol of hope as you walk the wasteland, for someday when the world is # ready we will surface and restore our battered Earth. Congratulations, you # have made us all very proud. I'll send Michael the authorization.

, it is time you wore your own suit of Power Armor. This is a very

entries.text: ，这是你的动力装甲。它是我们的特有装备。穿上动力装甲在废土行走你会更有信心，总有一天我们会面对并恢复这个破碎的世界。祝贺你，你让我们十分自豪。我会把你的授权给迈克尔。

I see someone else already gave you your Power Suit. I was hoping
 # to give it to you myself, but that's all right. I hope it helps you in

entries.text: 我知道他们已经准备好了你的动力装甲。我很希望亲自给你，但那样就好。我希望对你的旅行有帮助。

entries.text: Watch your form!
entries.source_text: Watch your form!

entries.text: 看看你的表现！
entries.source_text: 看看你的表现！

entries.text: Pay attention, people.
entries.source_text: Pay attention, people.

entries.text: 小心，平民。
entries.source_text: 小心，平民。

entries.text: No slacking off!
entries.source_text: No slacking off!

entries.text: 不要松懈！
entries.source_text: 不要松懈！

entries.text: Behave over there, or you'll find yourself on night perimeter patrol.
entries.source_text: Behave over there, or you'll find yourself on night perimeter patrol.

entries.text: 停下，否则你会发现你被派到夜间巡逻队的。
entries.source_text: 停下，否则你会发现你被派到夜间巡逻队的。

entries.text: Quiet, don't make me bring Rhombus in here. He'll whup all your asses.
entries.source_text: Quiet, don't make me bring Rhombus in here. He'll whup all your asses.

entries.text: 安静，不要让我打搅隆伯斯。他比你这头蠢驴强的多。
entries.source_text: 安静，不要让我打搅隆伯斯。他比你这头蠢驴强的多。

entries.source_text: Please, if you need something see me in the morning.

entries.source_text: 如果你有事找我，请早上来。

entries.text: I'll be in the training hall come morning. Talk to me then.
entries.source_text: I'll be in the training hall come morning. Talk to me then.

entries.text: 我早上会去训练场。过会再来。
entries.source_text: 我早上会去训练场。过会再来。

entries.text: What are you doing in her. These aren't your quarters.
entries.source_text: What are you doing in her. These aren't your quarters.

entries.text: 你在这里干什么。这里不是你的岗位。
entries.source_text: 你在这里干什么。这里不是你的岗位。

entries.text: Good night Initiate, talk to me in the morning. It can't be that # urgent.
entries.source_text:
Good night Initiate, talk to me in the morning. It can't be that
 # urgent.

entries.text: 晚上好新兵，早上来和我谈话。不要着急。
entries.source_text: 晚上好新兵，早上来和我谈话。不要着急。

entries.text: I'm tired and I want to go to bed, please leave.
entries.source_text: I'm tired and I want to go to bed, please leave.

entries.text: 我很累想去睡觉，请离开吧。
entries.source_text: 我很累想去睡觉，请离开吧。

entries.text: Do you normally bother people in there living quarters.
entries.source_text: Do you normally bother people in there living quarters.

entries.text: 你可以经常……等等。看着我的眼睛……向我想的一样。你应该戒掉药瘾，它们会让你神志不清。如果你不去看医生你就会像哈勃城的瘾君子那样死去。那么你需要什么？
